guide.add_project_setup.note:
The defaults are the answers the stack suggests: the choices you picked above, or none, and the shape of the other projects of its kind.
A web app is built for lcl, dev, uat and prd: smith run build builds prd, the builds go to dist/apps/<name>/<env>, and the .env files are written for you and kept in git.
The plan shows every default as a flag, and nothing is written before you say so.
